_doc: Known, understood cross-mod problems that the pack tests tolerate. Each entry must link
the issue that explains it; delete the entry when that issue is fixed.
errors: log errors tolerated by `packtool.py smoke` and the Atlas boot scenario. `pattern`
is a regex searched (not fully matched) in the message; keep it as narrow as the error allows.
schematicBlocks: BetterRuins schematic block codes allowed not to resolve. `pattern` must
match the whole code. Python `re` and .NET `Regex` must both accept every pattern.

errors.why: moreroads' stonebrick-* recipes also match Geology Additions / MN: Geology rocks it has no blocks for; the recipe is skipped.
errors.pattern: Grid Recipe 'moreroads:recipes/grid/[^']+': Output moreroads:\S+-(amphibolite|arenite|arkose|diorite|dolostone|gabbro|gneiss|jade|jasper|komatiite|marl|migmatite|monzonite|mudstone|pumice|pyroxenite|quartzite|rhyolite|schist|serpentinite|siltstone|syenite|tufa|wacke)-\S+ cannot be resolved\.

errors.why: doorvariants' stone-* recipes match Geology Additions' stone-bogiron item, which is not a rock; the recipe is skipped.
errors.pattern: Grid Recipe 'doorvariants:recipes/grid/doors/[^']+': Output doorvariants:\S+-bogiron-\S+ cannot be resolved\.

errors.why: IOG applies its mngeology+geoaddons ore patches before the geoaddons patch that creates the entry they edit.
errors.pattern: Patch \d+ \(target: interestingoregen:worldgen/deposits/(metalore|gems)/\w+\.json\) in interestingoregen:patches/mngeology/worldgen/geoaddons/(metalore|gems)/\w+\.json failed because supplied path /0/

errors.why: Scrolled's rolled locator map lists 18 Better Ruins map types but not forgottenvillage; that one roll recipe is skipped.
errors.pattern: Grid Recipe 'scrolled:locatormap-roll': Output scrolled:br-rolled-locatormap-forgottenvillage cannot be resolved\.

errors.why: BetterEr Prospecting reports its missing config file as an error on first boot, then writes the defaults.
errors.pattern: Failed to load config from file\. Creating a default config

schematicBlocks.why: Wool & More disables vanilla game:wool decor blocks (no remap); brmansion loses 4 wool decor placements.
